Marine images and movies from Remotely Operated Vehicle (ROV) - KH60, V Koster

https://doi.org/10.5878/1gp6-3423
The Marine stations at University of Gothenburg have several underwater recording facilities. One of them is the Remotely Operated Vehicle (ROV underwater robot) at Tjärnö marine station. This data source includes image and movie files, originating from ROV underwater surveys in the region of the Koster islands and Koster national park and date back to 1993.
